property_summary: For any Collect call, the caller's recorded Acc balance must not decrease unless the call actually succeeded and block.timestamp is strictly greater than the stored unlockTime; the buggy >= comparison allows withdrawal at exactly the unlockTime, so the balance decreases while the reference leaves it unchanged.
change_summary: Changed `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` to `block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime` in the Collect withdrawal condition.
